name: Open claims with paid-to-date (synthetic insurance data)

constitution.objective: Turn a claims-reporting requirement into one SQL view over the claims database.
hard_constraints: Read-only: never modify, drop or insert data.
Emit exactly one CREATE VIEW statement and nothing else.
stop_conditions: max_iter reached or token budget exceeded: stop with the best attempt.
Same failure class 3 consecutive iterations: escalate.
Any action outside permissions: hard stop.

baseline.text: You are a claims-reporting analyst. You write SQLite view definitions from plain-language requirements.

task.goal: One row per open claim, with its policy's product line and the total paid to date.
task.input: Requirement: for every open claim, show the claim, the product line of its policy, and how much has been paid on it so far. Claims with no payments yet still appear, with 0 paid.
task.output_contract: Return only SQL: CREATE VIEW open_claims_paid AS SELECT claim_id, product_line, paid_to_date ...;

context.text: Database tables: policies, claims, claim_payments. Column names are not listed here.
